settings.title: Also refresh Android Auto & CarPlay background workers
settings.description: Sends SIGTERM to HKMC_GPM (projection.sink) and HKMC_DiPO strictly while Bluetooth is off so stuck SPP/Bonjour sockets reset cleanly, while leaving PhoneProjection bound to PPService. Turn off to cycle Wi-Fi SoftAP and Bluetooth radios only.

settings.title: Automatic silent bounce on startup / standby wake
settings.description: Controls whether Bounce Connection also runs silently without toasts when waking from standby or starting the car.

options.title: Off (Manual Home Screen tile or ★ key only)
Smart Watchdog (If Bluetooth connects without CarPlay/AA within 15s)
Proactive (Bounce immediately on every standby / quick-stop wake)
